FIRSTAMENDMENT TOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "First Amendment') is made as of aAuacy : U2Y(the “Effective Date") between CHUANG HENG REGO PARK LLC, a NeW York limited liability company having an office at 463 Seventh Avenue, Suite 1603, New York, NY 10018 (*Developer") and THE ROMAN CATHOLIC CHURCH OF OUR LADY OF THE ANGELUS, IN THE BOROUGH OF QUEENS, IN THE CITY OF NEW YORK, a New York religious corporation, having offices at 63-63 98th Street, Rego Park, New York 11374 ("0LA"). RECITALS: A.Developer and OLA are parties to a certain Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated as of January 29, 2019 which was recorded in the Office of the New York City Register in Queens County on February 11, 2019 as CRFN 2019000046470 (the “ZLDA"); B.All capitalized terms used in this First Amendment which are not defined herein shall have the meanings set forth in the ZLDA; C. As of the Effective Date Developer continues to own the Developer Property and OLA continues to own the OLA Property, and Developer has commenced construction of the Developer Building; D. The parties wish to amend a provision of the ZLDA as set forth herein. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. TCO Date. The definition of"TCO Date" set forth in Section 1(i) of the ZLDA is hereby deleted and the following definition is substituted in its place: (i "TCO Date” shall mean the earlier of (i) January 29, 2025 or (i) the date of issuance of the first temporary Certificate of Occupancy allowing for the occupancy of the entire Developer Building. 2. Ratification of Agreement. The ZLDA, as modified by this First Amendment, remains in force and effect and is hereby ratified in all respects. [No further text on this page. Signature page follows.] 992622v.1
